title: G6 sensor errors
body: Getting G6 "sensor errors" and no BG results.  Reboot, restart sensor not working.

comments.body: The g6 will report that until it starts getting acceptable values again. Turn on the xdrip algo fallback option if u need to see values.

Worked for a bit, bit keeps automatically reverting to "G6 Native Mode"
then the box is no longer checked.

Which xDrip version are you using?

I am having this issue too..

Using latest build (2 nov)
I get this all the time.. thank god for the xdrip algo fallback option. Nothing u can do about that g6 cutting the feed and sending that sensor errors message. That seems to be a "feature" of the g6.
Oh you are referring to the reverting to native mode thing? Yeah that's odd. Happens to m too.

Note.. After toggling Bluetooth off and back in, restarting collector and restarting my phone a few times (to not success) I checked the 'fallback to xdrip' option and after a few minutes it kicked back in..

Went back into settings and it had unchecked (I imagine this is to do with being in native mode)

I'm using version 1809080944 currently with a new sensor; I was using the
nightly build (11-02 I believe) when I had the issues.

Everything was fine for the first few days, then would start getting sensor
errors.  Fallback worked for a day, then total sensor failure after 7 days.
